(b} Turn select switch of the actuator checker to the "F" posi­
tion.
(c} Push and hold in the "A" switch for a few seconds. Make
sure that you can hear the motor running.
(d) Depress the brake pedal and hold it until step (g) is com­
pleted.
(e) Push and hold in the εG" switch for a few seconds, and
check that the brake pedal does not go down.
NOTICE:
Do not keep the "G" switch pushed down for more than 10
seconds.
(I) Release the "G" switch and check that the pedal goes
down.
(g) Push the "A" switch and check that the pedal returns.
(h) Release the brake pedal.
